description: Employment-law reference for common contractual issues involving workers, restrictive covenants, and workplace compliance obligations.

obligations.title: Restrictive Covenant Enforceability
obligations.description: Restrictive covenants (e.g., non-solicitation, non-compete, non-interference) must be narrowly tailored and consistent with applicable state law requirements and evolving judicial standards.

obligations.title: Work Product and Confidentiality
obligations.description: Employment agreements should address ownership/assignment of work product created during employment and require protection of employer confidential information and trade secrets.

obligations.title: Notice and Post-Termination Obligations
obligations.description: Termination provisions should clearly define notice periods, cure periods, and which obligations survive termination (e.g., confidentiality and IP assignment).
